subject: BigQuery API requests for queries giving 404 on Shinyapps.io but 200 locally

messages.author: 1667ac6354bdba89
messages.subject: BigQuery API requests for queries giving 404 on Shinyapps.io but 200 locally
parts:
Hello Shinyapps team,

I have a vexing bug reported that I can't fathom why is happening.  Users report they can authenticate and perform other API calls such as requesting lists of tables, but when performing a query they get a 404 back.  The exact same Shiny app locally works as expected.

This behaviour looks to have started recently, so I wonder if anything could have changed on shinyapps.io that may have prompted it.

An example app demonstrating the bug is deployed here https://mark.shinyapps.io/bq-bug/

I took out the logs and compared to local requests via httr verbose logging, and they both look identical aside the 404 when requested from shinyapps.io - see below.

Does anyone have a clue what may be going on?  I.P. filtering is not possible by BigQuery, and its not authentication as other API calls can be performed.

Yours sincerely,
Mark

Logs below:
